evidence: Addresses PSBT data overpopulation in RPC methods descriptorprocesspsbt and utxoupdatepsbt, with regression tests in test/functional/rpc_psbt.py.
rationale: Fixes a bug where RPC methods combining multiple descriptors leak unrelated MuSig2 participant pubkeys, derivation paths, and leaf hashes into PSBT inputs and outputs. While MuSig2 descriptor workflows are specialized, preventing exposure of sensitive participant data and ensuring correctness of returned PSBTs warrants deliberate review under the RPC category.
